operators.name: custom_reduce_mean

returns.shape: same as input but with reduced dim kept as size 1

semantics: Reduces over the specified dimension while keeping it as size 1.
Computes float32 mean with correct division by length of dim.
Supports non-contiguous input via strided access or explicit contiguous copy; output is a new contiguous tensor with appropriate strides.
No extra bias or broadcasting beyond the reduction.
Reduces input shape [32,64,256,2048] over dimension 1 to produce [32,1,256,2048].
Mean is computed as sum of 64 values divided by 64 for each output element.
Keepdim ensures output retains the reduced dimension with size 1.
Reduces the intermediate [32,1,256,2048] over dimension 2 to produce [32,1,1,2048].
Mean is computed as sum of 256 values divided by 256 for each output element.
Returns the final reduced tensor [32,1,1,2048] with dtype float32 and device CUDA.
The returned tensor is the same object as the second reduction output; no additional computation.
